ssh_port.description: Port number for SSH access. Recommended: 22 (or a non-standard port for security hardening).

http_enabled.description: Enable HTTP (port 80) access to the server.

https_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS (port 443) access to the server.

icmp_enabled.description: Allow ICMP echo requests (ping). Useful for diagnostics; disable if not needed.

log_dropped.description: Log dropped packets via kernel logging (syslog). Enable for debugging; may generate high log volume.

services.description: List of custom services to allow. Each entry defines a service name, protocol, and port/icmp rule.

description.description: Optional description (shown in config comments only).

protocol.description: Network protocol. Use 'icmp' for ICMP rules (port field ignored).

port.description: TCP/UDP port number. Not used if protocol is 'icmp'.

icmp_type.description: ICMP type (e.g., 'echo-request', 'echo-reply', 'destination-unreachable'). Only used if protocol='icmp'.
